notes: The text is overwhelmingly clean: Arabic and English align on every record, and no chains, merges or misalignments appeared. The recurring defects are mechanical OCR slips in the Arabic (split or run-together words such as «مَ آلُ», «قَدْفَجَعَتْهُ»; doubled or misplaced diacritics such as «بِِهِ», «الزٌّهْدِ»), and fixes are proposed for those. About six chapter fields carry the Arabic title pasted in parentheses (e.g. 'Seclusion (الاِعتزال)'), and one record (8540) has a wrong chapter_ar. A few English apostrophes were lost ('ones', 'persons'), and two records (378 missing 'لا', 4374 starting mid-sentence) look truncated.
